messages.subject: Survey designs
parts:
While generating survey designs I have noticed that the number of samplers
reported in the Survey Plan Results section and those that are actually
generated differ. In one specific case the total samplers repoted in the
result section is 7. Where as if you go through the next couple of pages of
the result you will find 12 samplers have been generated. Given this how
does one calculate the 'Realized area coverage' and the 'proportion of area
covered'?
Is this a some kind of a bug?

Thanks
Srinivas V
Co-ordinator
Foundation for Ecological Research, Advocacy and Learning
Visit us at http://www.feralindia.org

Hi Srinivas,

This was a problem with Distance 4.0 which has been fixed in Distance 4.1 (see
list of resolved problems, number 253). Try the new version, and let me know if
you get any further problems,

- Len
